operator_decision: The current Project root Scope Unit has ID CA-SU-00, assigned in its specific R2640 Declaration; shared Project and Scope Unit ID rules do not require that prefix or ID for every Project. world is the predefined Scope Unit CA-SU--1 without a Scope Unit Declaration.
format_finding: Current R2526 declares Scope Unit.ID as string and does not prohibit leading zero. The current Project-specific declaration must preserve literal CA-SU-00 exactly; no shared prefix or numeric normalization is inferred.
dependencies: The specific R2640 root Project Declaration must receive CA-SU-00, preserving no parent and unordered/no order.number.
Current E670 and D442 explicitly say root has no ID and require coordinated source correction; M461 says ID where applicable and should align.
Retain D667/M461 root Project Authority folder .caprmedio_<project name> without an ID prefix; do not infer folder rename.
Coordinated Container group/bootstrap and dependent source/data migration remain outside this packet.
R2523 non-Project parent condition must exempt predefined world; see container-contracts packet.
limits: No Current or native Draft, code, tests, actual Workflow, Workbench or Git mutation.
